measurementNote: All matrix builds ran in one process with the source imported at implementationCommit. Pin those startup source hashes rather than later disk edits. The final follow-up only changes shared transport rate/auth cooldown handling; all 56 measured HTTP responses were 200, so these failure guards were dormant. Final negative fixtures and full tests validate the follow-up. Early harness B4 power-target/community-startup wiring was corrected before this final matrix; earlier incomplete runs are not extra evidence.
